sources.entry: Everything Claude Code (ECC) by Affaan Mustafa - Top-notch, well-written resources covering "just about everything" from core engineering domains. What's nice about this "everything-" store is most of the resources have significant standalone value and unlike some all-encompassing frameworks, although you can opt in to the author's own specific workflow patterns if you choose, the individual resou

summary.one_liner: ECC is an MIT-licensed collection of agents, skills, commands, hooks, rules, and memory tooling that adds a plan, test, review, and verify workflow to coding agents, primarily Claude Code.
summary.what_it_does: Provides 71 specialized subagents (planner, architect, TDD guide, code and language-specific reviewers, build-error resolvers, E2E runner), 311 on-demand skills covering TDD, security, docs, frontend, data, ML, and operations, and 97 legacy command shims. Hooks and memory handle session summaries, continuous learning, and context controls. Rules are opt-in by language or project. AgentShield scans prompts, hooks, MCP config, permissions, secrets, and agent files. Installation is through a guided npm/npx wizard (ecc-universal) or the native Claude plugin ecc@ecc, with a Codex native plugin path, a Qoder plugin, and capability-limited adapters for Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini, Zed, Copilot, and others.
use_cases: Add a plan-test-implement-review loop to Claude Code sessions
Run test-driven development with a dedicated TDD agent
Get a fresh-context code review of changes before merging
Scan agent configuration files, hooks, and MCP settings for security issues
Repair build errors in Go, Rust, Java, Kotlin, or C++ projects
Install a curated set of coding-agent skills and rules across harnesses
stack: Markdown agent, skill, and rule definitions
notable: Opt-in design: rules, hooks, and MCP servers are installed selectively, and only one default MCP connector ships
Multiple harness support with a published support status matrix noting capability limits per tool
AgentShield security scanner for agent configuration and secrets
Guided setup with dry-run, doctor, repair, and uninstall that track ECC-owned files in install-state
Explicit warnings to avoid stacking install methods, which can duplicate skills and hooks
caveats: Works best with Claude Code; other harnesses get adapters with reduced feature parity
Multi-model /multi-* commands need a separately installed ccg-workflow runtime, and Itô and Astra features need extra setup or a Codex CLI login
Claude plugin installs do not auto-enable bundled MCP servers and do not distribute rules, so these need manual setup
